
{{alias}}( value )
    Converts a line style string to a stroke dash array.

    If unable to resolve a stroke-dasharray, the function returns `null`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    value: string
        Line style string.

    Returns
    -------
    out: Array<number>|null
        Dash array.

    Examples
    --------
    > var out = {{alias}}( '--' )
    [ 5, 1 ]

    See Also
    --------
